endorsements.quote: As we begin to enter an era of algorithmic medicine, it will be important for all physicians to have some basic AI literacy4; an algorithmic consultation service does not obviate this need.

unlisted_practices: Establish an algorithmic consultation service staffed by physician-data science specialists who provide point-of-care guidance on AI tool selection and interpretation.

Have algorithmic consultants govern the institution's ecosystem of AI models, including selecting and vetting third-party models, validating candidate model performance on local data, and fine-tuning models to the local patient population.
Create a specialized algorithmic consultant training pathway within clinical informatics fellowship programs.
Incorporate basic probabilistic reasoning and data science principles into medical school curricula.

Have algorithmic specialists conduct background surveillance of AI use in the EHR and be automatically alerted to intervene when a provider uses an algorithm for a patient outside its intended condition.
Implement guardrails controlling which patients, scenarios, and physicians can use each AI model.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/perspective article proposing a new specialist role (physician-algorithm specialists) to oversee and guide AI implementation and governance in health care.
